picker.title: Move this conversation
picker.explainer: A project groups your work. It never changes what you can see: every fact stays yours, and stays visible outside the project.

lens.gapHint: Nothing in this project covers that.

delete.question: Delete the project "{{name}}"?
delete.consequence_one: The project groups {{count}} thing. Deleting removes the project only.
delete.consequence_many: The project groups {{count}} things. Deleting removes the project only.
delete.consequence_other: The project groups {{count}} things. Deleting removes the project only.
delete.keeps: Its conversations, sources, research runs and reports all stay exactly where they are and simply stop being in a project. Nothing is erased and no memory is deleted.
delete.alternative: To erase a document itself, delete that source on the Sources page, which runs the deletion saga and gives you a receipt. Archiving this project instead keeps everything and only hides it from the list.
